identificationModule.briefTitle: Comparing Complete Remission After Treatment With Selumetinib/Placebo in Patient With Differentiated Thyroid Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomised, Double Blind Study to Compare the Complete Remission Rate Following a 5-Week Course of Selumetinib or Placebo and Single Dose Adjuvant Radioactive Iodine Therapy in Patients With Differentiated Thyroid Cancer

interventions.name: Selumetinib
interventions.description: 3 capsules of 25 mg strength orally twice a day for approximately 5 weeks treatment period

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: 3 capsules ( to match Selumetinib capsules) orally twice a day for approximately 5 weeks treatment period

interventions.name: Radioactive Iodine Therapy
interventions.description: A single oral radioactive iodine dose of 100 mCI(3.7 GBq) 131I (+/-10% at the time of administration)to be administered 30 days after randomization. Additionaly, Thyrogen (Recombinant human TSH) will be used to stimulate iodine uptake according to the manufacturer's recommendation(0.9 mg intramuscular injection once a day for the 2 days prior to the dose of radioactive iodine)
